verdict.rationale: Mercury's API is versioned: base paths sit under /api/v1/ and the docs hub has a version picker listing v1-pre, v1 and v2. A public changelog gives dated change notices with migration guidance. However, the evidence says outright that no written deprecation or sunset policy is published anywhere on docs.mercury.com, so half the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods, explicit version lifecycle and support timelines, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
